source_title: Slickdeals Introduces The Sift, a New Way to Plan for Black Friday
source_excerpt:
The free feature brings announced Black Friday offers together in one searchable list, helping shoppers discover upcoming offers and plan purchases weeks before the sale
SAN MATEO, Calif. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Black Friday shopping doesn't have to start on Black Friday. Slickdeals , the community-powered platform helping millions of shoppers discover the best deals online, today introduced The Sift, a free tool that brings announced Black Friday offers together in one list, weeks before the official sale begins. Shoppers can compare upcoming offers, save the products they're interested in and build their shopping lists in advance. At launch, The Sift includes more than 1,500 offers from retailers including Costco, Sam's Club and Lowe's.
Traditionally, shoppers could flip through retailers' Black Friday ad scans to see what was coming and plan their purchases. Today, those offers are scattered across retailer announcements, websites and online discussions, making it harder to get a complete picture of what's ahead.
The Sift lets shoppers browse and search announced offers, filter by retailer, category or discount, and save the items they're considering, with no account required. Some offers stay sealed until each retailer's scheduled release date, so the list keeps growing as more Black Friday ads go public, giving shoppers a reason to check back.
The idea for The Sift grew out of a familiar challenge for deal hunters: keeping track of Black Friday offers before they go live. In recent years, Slickdeals community members have created their own comprehensive Black Friday spreadsheets to organize thousands of offers, earning enthusiastic feedback from fellow shoppers. The Sift builds on that same desire for a more organized shopping experience, bringing offers into a single searchable list that shoppers can sort, filter and personalize.
"Our community showed us what shoppers actually want before Black Friday: not more noise, but a way to see what's coming and decide early," said Johan Mengesha, Head of Content and Partnerships at Slickdeals. "The Sift takes the planning our members were doing by hand and makes it easy for every shopper, so they can go into the sale knowing exactly what they're waiting for."
Unlike Slickdeals' community-vetted deals, which members post, vote on and discuss, The Sift focuses on what retailers have announced is coming. Each listing links to the retailer or, when a corresponding Slickdeals deal becomes available, to that deal's community discussion and score.
One searchable list: Explore announced Black Friday offers from major retailers in one place.
Filters that fit your shopping plans: Narrow offers by retailer, category or discount level, or search for a specific product.
A look at what shoppers are saving: See which offers other shoppers are bookmarking, with a Top Saved badge highlighting popular offers in each category.
A personal shopping shortlist: Save offers without creating an account, then access your list on the same device and browser. Sign in to sync your list across devices and opt in to email reminders for upcoming offers.
A preview of what's still to come: Some retailer offers remain sealed until their scheduled release dates, giving shoppers a reason to check back as more Black Friday ads become available.
The Sift will evolve as Black Friday approaches. Around mid-November, it will also feature a selection of top community-voted deals from Slickdeals, helping shoppers move from planning their purchases to finding the deals that are live.
The Sift brings together the early research and planning that happen before Black Friday with the community-driven deal discovery Slickdeals is known for.
The Sift is available now for Black Friday 2026 at https://slickdeals.net/sift/black-friday-deals . Shoppers can start browsing on their phone or computer, with no account required.
About Slickdeals Slickdeals is a community-powered shopping platform where millions of shoppers share, vote on and discuss deals from leading retailers and brands. Since 1999, its community has put deals to the test, surfacing the best offers and calling out the rest, and helped shoppers save more than $10 billion. Through its website and mobile app, Slickdeals connects shoppers with worthwhile deals they might not find on their own. The deals you didn't see coming.
